blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Online information is increasingly consumed in video format. Much of this comes in the form of raw video : continuous footage taken on a cell phone, with a hand-held camera, or via CCTV, which is then directly uploaded to social media platforms and content sharing services. Whereas professional or even amateur-edited footage tends to feature scripted speech, chyrons, graphics, and metadata that help contextualize its subject matter, raw video typically contains none of these things, making it a much more challenging medium for information retrieval and machine understanding. To facilitate progress in this domain, we release MultiVENT-Raw , a multilingual collection of nearly 120,000 primarily raw videos (over 5,300 total hours), paired with 130 events and 222 event-centric queries, along with human-annotated video relevance judgments and human-extracted key facts for relevant videos. MultiVENT-Raw supports both a retrieval task—to identify videos in the collection relevant to a query event—and a generation task—to summarize event-related videos into a coherent report for a target user. We benchmark strong baselines on MultiVENT-Raw , showing both tasks to be challenging even for some of the latest multimodal models. 1 1 1 Code and data: https://github.com/hltcoe/multivent-raw .
blocks.zh: 在线信息越来越多地以视频形式使用。 这些影片大多以原始视频形式出现:在手机、手持相机或CCTV上连续拍摄, 虽然专业的甚至业余编辑的镜头往往以脚本化的演讲,chyrons,图形,和元数据为特色,帮助其主题的上下文化,但原始视频一般不包含这些内容,使它成为信息检索和机器理解更具挑战性的媒介. 为了促进这一领域的进展,我们发布了MultiVENT-Raw,该多语种集主要为原始视频(总时数超过5 300小时),配对130个事件和222个以事件为中心的询问,以及人文说明的视频相关判断和人文摘录的相关视频关键事实。 MultiVENT-Raw既支持检索任务——在收集中识别与查询事件有关的视频——又支持一代任务,将与事件有关的视频归纳成针对目标用户的连贯报告。 我们以“多VENT-Raw”为基准确定强有力的基线,表明即使对一些最新的多式联运模式而言,这两项任务都具有挑战性。 1 1 代码和数据:https://github.com/hltcoe/multive-raw 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Online information is increasingly conveyed in video. Beyond social media platforms and content sharing services—where video has long played a central role—even conventional print outlets now publish substantial amounts of video content online [ 10 , 34 , 40 ] . Much of this content is, in whole or in part, raw video: continuous footage filmed on cell phones, hand-held cameras, or CCTV, that is then uploaded, unedited, to an online platform. Whereas professional or edited footage contains large amounts of contextualizing information—such as narration, visual overlays, captions, and metadata—raw footage has far less of this content, and often none at all. Video of this kind thus poses unique challenges for multimodal retrieval and understanding: much of the context that is explicit in edited video is instead implicit in raw video, and must be inferred in order to match high-level user queries to relevant footage.
blocks.zh: 在线信息越来越多地通过视频传播。 除了社交媒体平台和内容共享服务——视频长期以来一直发挥中心作用——外,即使是传统的印刷机构现在也在网上公布大量视频内容[10、34、40]。 这些内容大多全部或部分是原始视频:连续拍摄的视频在手机、手持摄像机或闭路电视上拍摄,然后上传,未经编辑,上传到一个在线平台。 专业或编辑的片段包含大量背景信息——如叙述、视觉叠加、标题和元数据——而粗略的片段却远不如这些内容,而且往往根本没有。 因此,这种视频对多式联运检索和理解提出了独特的挑战:经过编辑的视频中明确的内容大都隐含在原始视频中,必须加以推断,以便将高层次用户查询与有关视频相匹配。

blocks.en:
Despite the centrality of raw video to digital platforms, benchmarks for video retrieval and understanding focus overwhelmingly on simple user queries over edited videos [ 36 , 43 , 20 , 6 , 26 ] . To remedy this, we introduce MultiVENT-Raw —a large, multilingual collection of raw video for retrieval and generation against complex, event-centric queries. MultiVENT-Raw spans 130 events, 222 queries, 8 languages, and nearly 120,000 videos, totaling over 5,300 hours of footage ( Fig. 1 ). Relevance judgments are annotated manually for all queries, and key facts, or claims , are manually written for all relevant videos for each query. MultiVENT-Raw topics cover a range of recent, real-world events, including natural disasters, protests, cultural celebrations, technological developments, and political incidents, among others. A further distinguishing feature of MultiVENT-Raw is its coverage of anomalies : a subset of topics focuses on unusual occurrences drawn from livestream cameras from around the world, which were sampled at regular intervals over the course of 11 months.
In summary, we: 1. Release MultiVENT-Raw , a large multilingual benchmark for retrieval and reasoning over raw videos, spanning 8 languages, 130 events, 222 queries, and nearly 120,000 videos. 2. Release MicroVENT , a smaller dev set covering 23 events, useful for fast iteration on system development. 3. Present baseline results on retrieval and generation, showing MultiVENT-Raw to be a challenging benchmark for both tasks.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: There are many benchmarks for video retrieval, spanning different video collections and catering to different use cases. Many notable benchmarks, such as MSVD [ 4 ] , Valor-32K [ 23 ] , InternVid [ 43 ] , and MSR-VTT [ 48 ] , focus exclusively on shorter, English-only video clips (averaging ≤ {\leq} 15 seconds), often segmented from longer ones. Some benchmarks, such as VATEX [ 42 ] and Multi-HowTo100M [ 17 ] , do have queries in multiple languages, but not videos with multilingual speech content. All of the above benchmarks use video summaries or scene captions as queries. This has the advantage of scalability, but can result in bland, artificial queries that are not representative of real information needs. Lastly, the videos in these collections focus heavily (or even exclusively) on edited and professional content.
blocks.zh: 视频检索有许多基准,涉及不同的视频收藏,并针对不同的使用案例。 许多值得注意的基准,如MSVD[4],Valor-32K[23],InternVid[43],以及MSR-VTT[48],专注在短短的,只限英语的视频片段(average ~ ~leq}15秒),经常从更长的片段中分离出来. 一些基准,如VATEX[42]和Multi-HowTO100M[17],确实有多种语言的查询,但没有包含多语种语音内容的视频. 上述所有基准都使用视频摘要或场景字幕作为查询. 这有伸缩性的优点,但可能导致不能够代表真实信息需求的人为查询。 最后,这些藏品中的视频主要(甚至完全)关注编辑和专业内容。

blocks.en: Addressing some of the points above, Sanders et al. [ 36 ] introduce MultiVENT 1.0 , a benchmark for event-centric video retrieval that covers 255 events (from 2015 to 2023) and ∼ {\sim} 2,400 videos (both edited and raw) in multiple languages (Arabic, Chinese, English, Korean, and Russian). Queries are one- or two-sentence English event descriptions drawn from relevant text documents (e.g., news articles).

MultiVENT 2.0 [ 20 ] expands MultiVENT 1.0 to roughly 3,900 queries and 218,000 videos, covering the same event types and languages (+Spanish), and drawing on InternVid to source the additional videos. Queries in MultiVENT 2.0 are more fine-grained than in MultiVENT 1.0 , and ask about specific aspects of the target events (e.g., Changsha skyscraper fire casualties ) based on annotations from [ 37 ] . This dataset also supported a shared task at the first Workshop on Multimodal Augmented Generation via Multimodal Retrieval (MAGMaR) [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: MultiVENT 2.0 [20] 将MultiVENT 1.0扩展至约3,900个查询和218,000个视频,涵盖同一事件类型和语言(+西班牙语),并借鉴InternVid来源补充视频. 多VENT 查询 2.0比MultiVENT 1.0更精细,根据[37]的注释询问目标事件(如长沙摩天大楼火灾伤亡)的具体方面. 该数据集还支持了第一次通过多式联运检索生成增强多式联运讲习班的一项共同任务[19]。

blocks.en: MultiVENT-Raw differs from all of the above in (1) limiting relevant videos to raw content only; (2) expanding language coverage (adding Pashto, Farsi, and Urdu to the set of languages covered by MultiVENT 1.0 and 2.0 ); and (3) using realistic, multi-sentence analytic queries rather than short questions or event descriptions.
blocks.zh: MultiVENT-Raw与上述所有不同:(1) 将相关视频限制在原始内容;(2) 扩大语言覆盖面(将普什图语、波斯语和乌尔都语添加到MultiVENT 1.0和2.0涵盖的一套语言中);(3) 使用现实的,多判决分析的询问,而不是简短的问题或事件描述。

blocks.en: Text-to-video retrieval systems typically follow a two-stage retrieve-then-rerank pipeline that pairs an efficient first-stage retriever with a more expressive reranker. Most first-stage retrievers are dense bi-encoders that embed queries and videos as single vectors [ 25 , 49 , 5 , 53 , 15 , 22 ] or multiple vectors [ 32 , 30 ] . In the second stage, video-native reranking models rescore an initial candidate list by reasoning over video content directly [ 39 , 22 ] . As an alternative to encoding video directly, some systems derive video representations from extracted or generated text [ 46 , 7 ] , or encode each modality independently and fuse the resulting rankings [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh: 文本到视频检索系统一般遵循两个阶段的检索-当时的后排管道,将高效的第一阶段检索器与更显式的重新排名器配对. 大多数第一级检索器是密集的双编码器,将查询和视频嵌入作为单向量[25,49,5,53,15,22]或多向量[32,30]. 在第二阶段,视频本地化的重新排位模型通过对视频内容的推理直接[39,22]重排一个初始候选名单. 作为直接编码视频的替代办法,一些系统从提取或生成的文本[46,7]中获取视频表示,或独立地对每种模式进行编码,并调整由此产生的排名[35]。

blocks.en: The report generation task that MultiVENT-Raw supports is a multi -video retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) task. While there is substantial work on single- video RAG [ 52 , 24 , 12 , 21 ] , work in the multi-video setting has only recently begun to receive meaningful attention—likely due not only to high compute costs, but also to the lack of native support for multi-video processing even in the most recent multimodal models. Ren et al. [ 33 ] introduce the VideoRAG framework, which enables information synthesis over multiple videos via a knowledge graph constructed from entities and relations attested in individual videos. Tevissen et al. [ 41 ] perform multi-video RAG entirely in text, indexing videos on speech transcripts and visual metadata, and retrieving over this index to answer simple questions about an archive of NASA footage. Lastly, the second MAGMaR Workshop [ 29 ] organized a shared task around the WikiVideo benchmark from [ 26 ] , which requires generating a Wikipedia-style article about a query event based on videos retrieved from a subset of the MultiVENT 2.0 dataset. In § 5 , we present results both with the baseline system for this shared task (CAG [ 26 ] ) and with two top participant systems (TRACE [ 50 ] and MARQUIS [ 3 ] ).
blocks.zh: MultiVENT-Raw支持的报告生成任务是一种多视频检索增强生成(RAG)的任务. 虽然在单视频RAG[52,24,12,21]方面有大量工作,但多视频设定方面的工作直到最近才开始受到有意义的关注——可能不仅因为计算成本高,而且因为即使在最近的多模式中也缺乏对多视频处理的本土支持. 任等编. [33] 引入VideoRAG框架,该框架通过由实体构建的知识图和在个人视频中证实的关系,使信息能够综合多个视频。 特维森等. [41] 完全用文字进行多视频RAG,在语音记录和视觉元数据上索引视频,并检索这个索引,以回答有关NASA镜头存档的简单问题. 最后,第二次MAGMAR讲习班[29]围绕[26]的WikiVideo基准安排了一个共同的任务,这需要制作一篇维基百科风格的文章,内容是根据从MultiVENT 2.0数据集的一个子集中检索的视频,进行查询的事件。 在第5款中,我们用这一共同任务的基准系统(CAG[26])和两个最高参与系统(TRACE[50]和MARQUIS[3])提出结果。

blocks.zh: 3个 数据收集

blocks.en: MultiVENT-Raw contains raw video. We define this as continuous footage that is effectively unscripted and unedited---excluding video with scripted speech, narration, music tracks, graphical or text overlays (e.g., chyrons, captions), or multiple scenes. Thus, news broadcasts, amateur-edited videos, and compilations are all filtered out. 2 2 2 Minimal graphical and text overlays are permitted in select cases (e.g., channel logos in the corner of the screen or timestamps from livestream cameras) when the footage is otherwise fully raw.
blocks.zh: 多VENT-Raw包含原始视频. 我们将此定义为有效的无标注和未经编辑的连续镜头——不包括带有脚本演讲,叙事,音乐音轨,图形或文字覆盖(如chyrons,标题)的视频,或多个场景. 因此,新闻广播、业余编辑的视频和汇编都经过过滤。 2 2 最小图形和文本覆盖在特定情况下(如屏幕角落的频道标志或来自活流相机的时标)允许,否则镜头是完全原始的.

blocks.en: 3.1 Topic and Video Curation
blocks.zh: 3.1 专题和录像说明

blocks.en: Data collection for MultiVENT-Raw began with topic curation. The curation process differed for our primary events , drawn mainly from cell phone and hand-held camera footage, and our anomaly events , drawn entirely from livestreams and CCTV cameras.
blocks.zh: MultiVENT-Raw的数据收集始于专题解析. 主要来自手机和手持相机镜头,

blocks.en: We sought to make MultiVENT-Raw a multilingual benchmark, focusing on eight target languages—Arabic, Chinese, Farsi, Korean, Pashto, Russian, Spanish, and Urdu—chosen based on the linguistic competencies of available annotators (see § 3.3 ). For each target language, we searched the web for recent events in countries where that language is widely spoken, though we did not require videos depicting these events to contain speech. Further, although we placed no hard restrictions on the types of events to curate, we prioritized those that seemed likely to have been documented in raw video footage. 3 3 3 Thus, this process selects against types of events likely to receive coverage only in highly edited form (e.g., political debates, diplomatic talks, or financial incidents). Local and recent events were also prioritized to minimize the likelihood and extent of their coverage in the training data of current multimodal models. Our search involved a mix of manual discovery on news sites and social media platforms (YouTube, TikTok, and X) and automatic discovery via a Claude skill that we designed for this purpose [ 1 ] . In both cases, an event was retained only if we were able to find multiple raw videos depicting it.
blocks.zh: 我们力求使MultiVENT-Raw成为一个多语种基准,侧重于八种目标语言——阿拉伯语、中文、波斯语、朝鲜语、普什图语、俄语、西班牙语和乌尔都语——根据现有注释者的语言能力进行选择(见第3.3节)。 尽管我们并不要求描述这些事件的视频包含言论内容, 此外,虽然我们没有严格限制要处理的事件类型,但我们优先考虑那些似乎可能记录在原始录像中的事件。 3 3 因此,这一进程针对可能仅以高度编辑的形式报道的事件类型(如政治辩论、外交会谈或财务事件)。 当地和最近的活动也被列为优先事项,以尽可能减少在目前多式联运模式的培训数据中涵盖这些活动的可能性和范围。 我们的搜索涉及在新闻网站和社交媒体平台(YouTube、TikTok和X)上的人工发现和通过我们为此设计的克劳德技能自动发现的组合[1]。 在这两种情况下,只有我们能够找到多个描绘它的原始视频,活动才得以保留.

blocks.en: Anomaly events are occurrences captured on a livestream that are somehow unusual compared to the typical activity on that stream. Relative to our primary events, they add two further challenges. First, since they are sourced from individual cameras, they are even less likely to have received media coverage and thus to have representation in models’ training data. Second, the camera activity corresponding to the event of interest is typically embedded within tens or hundreds of minutes of similar footage (vs. only several minutes for primary events).
blocks.zh: 异常事件是在活流中捕捉到的事件,与该流的典型活动相比,这在某种程度上是不寻常的。 相对于我们的主要事件,它们又增加了两个挑战。 首先,由于它们是从个别摄像头获得的,因此更不可能得到媒体的报道,从而在模型的培训数据中得到反映。 其次,与感兴趣的事件相对应的相机活动一般在类似镜头的数十分钟或数百分钟内嵌入(vs只为主事件几分钟).

blocks.en: For anomaly events, we curated topics from a pool of 322 public livestream cameras, which we sampled at regular intervals over 11 months (June 2025 through April 2026). The resulting 24,459 clips come from cameras in over 20 countries and depict diverse locations including traffic intersections, parks, rail lines, harbors, airports, and volcanoes. Our annotators identified anomalies by first reviewing each camera’s footage to establish a normal activity profile, and then selecting clips that deviate from that profile. We dropped cameras where more than 4% of clips were judged anomalous, and each remaining camera with at least one anomaly became a topic. Topics cover a diverse range of events—e.g., a volcanic eruption, a team of fire trucks driving onto an airport runway, and a car parking on the grass in a park in the middle of the night.
blocks.zh: 对于异常事件,我们从322台公共直播相机的集合中整理了话题,我们在11个月(2025年6月至2026年4月)的时间里定期取样. 所产生的24 459个剪辑来自20多个国家的摄像头,描绘了包括交通交叉点、公园、铁路线、港口、机场和火山在内的不同地点。 我们的注释员首先通过审查每部相机的镜头来建立正常的活动概况,然后选择偏离该简介的片段来识别异常. 我们放下了相机 超过4%的片段 被判定为异常, 而每个剩余的相机 至少有一个异常 成为话题。 主题涉及各种各样的事件——例如火山爆发、一队消防车开到机场跑道上,以及半夜在公园的草地上停放一辆汽车。

blocks.en: All primary event videos and all anomalous clips identified above are deemed relevant to the corresponding event. For anomaly events, all remaining (irrelevant) clips are retained in the collection as hard negatives. For primary events, we mined hard negatives by retrieving videos from a larger candidate collection, sourced primarily from YouTube, with additional videos from X and TikTok. We retrieved candidates using Qwen3-VL-Embedding (8B) [ 22 ] representations of visual keyframes and Qwen3-Embedding (8B) [ 54 ] representations of speech transcripts and OCR text, produced by Qwen3-ASR (1.7B) [ 38 ] and PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 [ 55 ] , respectively. For each query, we ranked candidates by embedding similarity and retained high-scoring clips after excluding videos that were already judged relevant to that query.
blocks.zh: 所有初级事件视频和上面确认的所有异常片段被认为与相应的事件相关. 对于异常事件,所有剩余的(无关的)剪辑都保留在收藏中作为硬底片. 对于初级事件,我们挖掘了硬底片,从一个较大的候选集中检索视频,主要来源于YouTube,还有来自X和TikTok的更多视频。 我们利用Qune3-VL-Embedding(8B)和Qune3-Embedding(8B)分别由Qune3-ASR(1.7B)[38]和PaddleOCR-VL-1.6[55]制作的语音记录誊本和OCR文本,检索了候选人。 对于每个查询,我们通过嵌入相似性对候选人进行排名,并保留高分片段,然后排除已经判断与该查询相关的视频。

blocks.en: A second round of manual relevance judgments was conducted following training of retrieval baselines on this collection, with annotations collected on the top 20 relevant videos for each query as judged by these baselines (see § ​ 5 \lx@sectionsign\ref{sec:experiments} ). These relevance judgments were then added to the originals to yield the final set of judgments for the collection.
blocks.zh: 在对本汇编的检索基线进行培训之后,进行了第二轮人工相关判断,并在根据这些基线判断的每个查询前20个相关视频上收集了说明(见§5\lx@sectionsign\ref{sec:experiments})。 这些相关的判决随后被添加到原件中,以产生收集的最后一套判决。

blocks.en: In total, we identified 703 relevant videos covering 130 events (96 primary, 34 anomaly), of which 102 events occurred in 2025–2026. Fig. 1 shows the breakdown of relevant videos by language. The remaining 118,099 videos in the collection are hard negatives.
blocks.zh: 我们总共确定了703个相关视频,涉及130个事件(96个主要事件,34个异常事件),其中102个事件发生在2025-2026年. 图1显示按语言分列的相关视频。 馆藏的其余118,099段视频为硬底片.

blocks.en: 3.2 Query and Persona Development
blocks.zh: 3.2 查询和人员发展

blocks.en: For each topic, we sought to develop queries that capture complex, realistic information needs. More specifically, we wanted queries that were more analytical than those in related work (e.g., [ 36 , 20 ] ), that would require reasoning over multiple videos, and that might plausibly have been asked by someone affected by the target event.
blocks.zh: 就每个专题而言,我们力求提出能够反映复杂、现实的信息需要的询问。 更具体地说,我们想要的是比相关工作(如[36,20])中更具有分析性的询问,这些询问需要对多个视频进行推理,而且可能会是受目标事件影响的人所询问的。

blocks.en: To aid in query development, we first crafted a profile, or persona , describing a hypothetical person who would have a stake in the event and its consequences. Each persona consists of a job title and description (see Fig. 2 ), which provide broader context for the query, and may be used alongside it for both retrieval and generation.
blocks.zh: 为了帮助查询开发,我们首先设计了一个简介,或者个人,描述一个假设的人,他与事件及其后果有利害关系。 每人a 包括一个职称和说明(见图2),为查询提供更广泛的背景,并可用于检索和生成。

blocks.en: There are at least two types of information need a user might have about a target event. On the one hand, they may be interested in finding any and all information about the event that is relevant to their responsibilities, requiring a system to find and summarize a broad set of related videos. On the other hand, the user may have a more specific set of questions about what happened, requiring a system to find particular videos that address these questions or else determine that no answer can be found. Accordingly, for each primary event, we construct two queries—one for each type of need. For both, a small initial query set was manually written by the authors. These queries then informed the creation of a Claude skill that was used to write the remainder.
blocks.zh: 用户至少需要两种关于目标事件的信息。 一方面,他们可能有兴趣找到任何和所有与其职责相关的事件信息,要求一个系统查找和总结一系列广泛的相关视频. 另一方面,用户可能会对所发生的事情有一套更具体的问题,要求一个系统找到针对这些问题的特定视频,或者确定找不到答案. 因此,对于每个主要活动,我们提出两个问题——每个类型的需要一个。 对于两者,一个小型的初始查询集是由作者手动写的. 这些查询随后告知了克劳德技能的创造,该技能被用来写下其余的.

blocks.en: Broad queries capture the first use case and are written based on the persona and the claim annotations (see § 3.3 ) from all relevant videos for the target event. We use the claim annotations so that the query conforms to the set of event-related information actually attested in the collection, consistent with the summarization-style objective.
blocks.zh: 宽泛的查询捕捉到第一个使用案例,并基于人物和来自目标事件所有相关视频的诉求说明(见第3.3节)编写. 我们使用索赔说明,以便查询符合收集中实际证实的与事件有关的一组信息,符合归纳式的目标。

blocks.en: Narrow queries cover the second use case and are written based only on the persona and the titles of relevant videos. In this way, queries are informed at a high level by relevant content attested in the collection, but are also free to pose questions for which the collection may supply no answers.
blocks.zh: 狭义的查询涵盖第二个使用案例,只根据人物和相关视频的标题来写. 这样,在高层次上通过收集中证实的相关内容向查询提供信息,但也可自由提出收集中可能无法提供答案的问题。

blocks.en: Since anomaly detection fits a summarization-style objective—where any and all anomalous incidents are to be flagged—we write only broad queries for the anomaly events. In total, we obtain 222 queries.
blocks.zh: 由于异常现象的检测符合概括式的目标——任何和所有异常事件都应标出——我们只为异常事件写出广泛的查询。 我们总共得到222个查询。

blocks.en: 3.3 Claim Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.3 索赔说明

blocks.en: To enable reliable evaluation of our generation task (§ 4.2 ), we annotated key facts, or claims , for each relevant video. Annotators were given a target persona, asked to watch a video, and then asked to write claims (in English) that capture important information from the video that the target persona would likely want to know. Annotators further provided confidence scores (0--100) for each claim 4 4 4 In practice, annotators were asked not to write claims for which their confidence score was < {<} 50, as this would suggest they believe the claim to be more likely false than true. and indicated which of the video’s modalities provided evidence for the claim, with the option to select multiple: (a) the visual frames, excluding text; (b) the on-screen text; (c) the speech; or (d) the non-speech audio.
blocks.zh: 为了能够可靠地评价我们这一代人的任务(第4.2节),我们为每一段相关视频注释了关键事实或声称。 Annoters被赋予了目标人物a,要求观看视频,然后要求写下从视频中获取重要信息的诉求(英语),而目标人物a可能想知道. 注释者还为每项索赔提供了信心分数(0-100) 4 4 并注明录像的哪些方式为索赔提供了证据,可选择选择多种:(a) 视觉框架,不包括文字;(b) 屏幕上的案文;(c) 发言;或(d) 非语音音频。

blocks.en: Linguists with expertise in each of our target languages were recruited to perform the annotation, using the Flexible Ontology Visual Event Analyzer (FOVEA) annotation tool to do so [ 45 ] . All annotators were given a tutorial as well as a detailed set of written instructions, and completed a practice annotation that was reviewed and discussed with the authors. Annotators were also permitted to ask clarifying questions throughout the task. In total, annotators wrote roughly 5,800 claims across the 703 relevant videos in MultiVENT-Raw , averaging 8.25 claims per video.

blocks.en: 3.4 Quality Control and Postprocessing
blocks.zh: 3.4 质量控制和后处理

blocks.en: Although annotated videos were manually verified as raw, irrelevant videos in the collection (obtained via hard negative mining) could not be verified in the same way, given their large number.
blocks.zh: 虽然附加说明的录像被人工核实为原始录像,但由于其数量庞大,无法以同样的方式核实收藏中的不相关录像(通过硬反面挖掘获得)。

blocks.en: Accordingly, we developed a classifier to distinguish raw from edited videos. To do so, we relied on the raw/edited labels provided for the MultiVENT 2.0 test set [ 20 ] , dividing this randomly into train (85%) and dev (15%) splits. We assessed an array of different classifier designs, the best of which was an ensemble system that aggregates predictions from two zero-shot prompted VLMs, two fine-tuned generative VLM classifiers, and a classifier based on FFmpeg features [ 11 ] . 5 5 5 Appendix A has further details on this classifier. This classifier achieved an F 1 \text{F}_{1} of 91.4% on the dev set, indicating high reliability. The classifier was then run over all irrelevant videos in the collection.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们开发了一个分类器来区分原始视频和编辑视频。 为此,我们依靠为MultiVENT 2.0测试集提供的原始/编辑标签[20],将这个随机划分为列车(85%)和dev(15%)拆分. 我们评估了一系列不同的分类器设计,其中最好的是集合两个零射激发VLM的预测的组合系统,两个微调基因的VLM分类器,以及一个基于FFmpeg特性的分类器 [11]. 5 5 5 附录 A有关于这个分类器的进一步细节. 这个分类器在dev集上实现了91.4%的F 1\text{F}_{1},表明可靠性很高. 分类器随后被运行到收藏中的所有无关视频.

blocks.en: Since raw video retrieval use cases include settings where edited videos are present in the collection and settings where they are not, we define two splits of MultiVENT-Raw : Full , which contains all 118,802 original videos and Core , which removes all irrelevant videos labeled as edited by our classifier, leaving 59,196.
blocks.zh: 由于原始视频检索使用的案例包括收藏中存在编辑的视频的设置和没有这些视频的设置,我们定义了MultiVENT-Raw的两个拆分: Full ,其中包含所有118,802原始视频和Core ,它删除了所有被我们分类者标注为编辑的不相关视频,留下59,196个.

blocks.en: Claim postprocessing involved three tasks, all implemented as Claude skills that drew on insights from an initial manual review of annotated claims.
blocks.zh: 索赔后处理涉及三项任务,全部作为克劳德的技能执行,这些技能借鉴了对附加说明的索赔的初步人工审查。

blocks.en: The first task was to ensure that all claims were unique, atomic (short, non-compound), and self-contained (e.g., with ambiguous references resolved). Claims that could not be rewritten to satisfy these criteria were discarded.
blocks.zh: 第一项任务是确保所有主张都是独特的、原子性的(简短的、非综合的)和自成一体的(例如,解决了模棱两可的提法)。 无法为达到这些标准而改写的索赔被放弃。

blocks.en: The second task was to filter the original set of claims ( original claims ) into subsets depending on their relevance to the target event ( event claims ), persona ( persona claims ), and query ( query claims ). Although annotators were instructed to write persona claims (§ 3.3 ), in practice we found that some annotated claims were overly general (i.e., were more properly classed as event claims) and that only a subset were further relevant to the query (i.e., were query claims). Here, we assume that { query claims } ⊆ { persona claims } ⊆ { event claims } ⊆ { original claims } \{\textit{query claims}\}\subseteq\{\textit{persona claims}\}\subseteq\{\textit{event claims}\}\subseteq\{\textit{original claims}\} .

blocks.en: The third task was to augment query claims with negative claims —claims asserting that no answer to some facet of the query is provided by the collection. We write one such claim for each facet for which this is the case. Note that, because negative claims are not grounded in any video, they lack modality support annotations (in contrast to the other positive claims).
blocks.zh: 第三项任务是用否定的索偿要求来增加查询要求——声称收集资料没有答复查询的某些方面。 我们为每个方面写一份这样的索赔,情况就是这样。 请注意,由于负面索赔没有基于任何视频,因此缺乏模式支持说明(与其他正面索赔相反)。

blocks.zh: 3.5 微频

blocks.en: To facilitate more rapid system development, and to allow all of MultiVENT-Raw to serve as a test set, we release alongside it a dev set that we call MicroVENT . MicroVENT consists of 23 events, 31 queries (23 biased, 8 unbiased), and 933 total videos (272 annotated). Like MultiVENT-Raw , MicroVENT covers both primary events (18) and anomaly events (6), curated and annotated in the same fashion described above. Unlike MultiVENT-Raw , however, 10 of the primary events in MicroVENT are drawn from events in MultiVENT 2.0 , which covers similar types of events to MultiVENT-Raw (see § 2 ). As with the Full split of MultiVENT-Raw , we do not filter out edited videos from the MicroVENT collection.

blocks.en: 4.1 Video Retrieval
blocks.zh: 4.1 视频检索

blocks.en:
Given a query q e q_{e} about an event e e , an ideal retrieval system should return a ranked list of n n videos from the collection, L q e = [ v 1 , … , v n ] L_{q_{e}}=[v_{1},\ldots,v_{n}] , where all videos relevant to q e q_{e} are ranked higher than all irrelevant videos. In § 5 , we use the annotated queries as q e q_{e} , excluding the personas.
We report recall@ k k (R@ k k ) for k ∈ { 20,100 } k\in\{20,100\} (where k ≤ n k\leq n ), defined as the fraction of all q e q_{e} -relevant videos in the collection that appear among the top k k of L q e L_{q_{e}} , averaged over all q e q_{e} . We also report nDCG@ k k for k ∈ { 10 , 20 } k\in\{10,20\} , which measures the degree to which L q e L_{q_{e}} approximates a perfect rank order.
4.2 Report Generation
blocks.zh: 4.2 报告的生成

blocks.en: Our report generation task is similar to the event-centric article generation task from the WikiVideo benchmark [ 26 ] . Given e e , q e q_{e} , and L q e L_{q_{e}} , a system must produce a report that addresses q e q_{e} as completely and accurately as possible, with citations to one or more supporting videos v ∈ L q e v\in L_{q_{e}} appended following each report sentence that requires evidential support. 6 6 6 In our experiments, we assume that every report sentence requires evidential support. We consider two settings: a RAG setting, where L q e L_{q_{e}} is provided by a retrieval system (§ 4.1 ) and an Oracle setting, where L q e L_{q_{e}} consists of the ideal ranked list for q e q_{e} ( L q e ∗ L^{*}_{q_{e}} ). Whereas the former setting represents our primary task of interest, the latter allows us to assess upper bounds on generation performance, independent of retrieval quality. We evaluate predicted report quality with MiRAGE [ 27 ] , a suite of metrics for multimodal RAG tasks that measure the degree to which a report both (a) recovers facts known to be attested by relevant videos (information precision, recall, and F1 score) and (b) provides appropriate citation for its claims (citation precision, recall, and F1 score). 7 7 7 Appendix B has details on these metrics.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We have introduced MultiVENT-Raw , a benchmark for retrieval and generation over raw, event-centric video that spans 130 events and nearly 120,000 videos. To enable rapid system development on both tasks, we also release MicroVENT —a dev set comprising 23 events and close to 1,000 videos. Further, we present baseline results on both tasks. For retrieval, we show that even strong baselines that pair first-stage dense retrieval methods with recent video rerankers show middling performance (§ 5.1 ), testifying to MultiVENT-Raw ’s difficulty. We show that raw video retrieval is especially challenging when retrieving over a mixture of both raw and edited video. On generation (§ 5.2 ), we see similarly underwhelming performance, where models struggle both with effectively recovering key information for the target queries and with providing appropriate citations. Nonetheless, with the recent rapid improvements in multimodal models, we are confident that further advances in retrieval and reasoning over raw video are in store, and we release MultiVENT-Raw to track this progress.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了MultiVENT-Raw, 以事件为中心的原始视频为基准进行检索和生成, 为了能够迅速发展系统,我们还发布了MicroVENT——一个包含23个事件和近1 000个视频的dev集。 此外,我们提出了这两项任务的基线结果。 为了检索,我们显示,即使将第一阶段密集检索方法与近期的视频重新排行榜相结合的强基线也显示出了干扰性能(§5.1),这证明了MultiVENT-Raw的困难。 我们显示,原始视频检索在通过原始视频和编辑视频混合检索时尤其具有挑战性。 在生成方面(第5.2节),我们同样认为,在生成方面,模型在有效恢复目标查询的关键信息以及提供适当引用方面都有困难。 尽管如此,随着最近多式联运模式的迅速改进,我们相信,在原始视频的检索和推理方面正在取得进一步的进展,我们发布了MultiVENT-Raw,以跟踪这一进展。

blocks.en: We evaluate the MiRAGE metrics under the “reference” (as opposed to “collection”) setting for all reported numbers. This means we use the reference set of query claims for the target query to assess the support of claims in a predicted report, rather than assessing support directly against the video content. We refer the reader to [ 27 ] for additional discussion of the reference vs. collection distinction. We detail several additional metric implementation decisions below.

blocks.en: We decompose claims with the prompt in Figure 9 , adapting methods from [ 14 ] and [ 44 ] for claim decomposition and decontextualization. This is particularly important for handling long predicted reports, as it enables individual claims to be understood and evaluated independently, without the need to provide long passages as contextualizing information.

blocks.en: One of our baseline systems, TRACE, produces exceptionally long predicted reports (often ≥ \geq 10,000 sentences per report). The length of these reports causes issues with context rot and instruction following in our claim verification for the MiRAGE precision and recall metrics. For precision, claim decontextualization helps with this issue, as verifying a predicted claim against the reference claims can be done without the predicted text to help contextualize the claim.
